title: Pirates Had Injury Insurance #Shorts
description:
Pirates had injury insurance. Seriously. One buccaneer crew in the 1670s agreed on a price list for injuries, paid from the shared loot. Lose your right arm? Six hundred pieces of eight. Your left arm, five hundred.
